description: MeshCore repeater firmware with a Meshtastic beacon built in — the repeater periodically announces itself on a Meshtastic network (map pin + optional text), then returns to its MeshCore channel. Meshtastic packets default to 0 hops (direct neighbors only, never rebroadcast). Same MeshCore protocol otherwise; configured over the serial CLI with the mtbeacon commands.

v0.2.3.notes: MeshCore repeater with the Meshtastic beacon built in: it periodically retunes to the Meshtastic channel, emits NodeInfo/Position/text so it appears on the Meshtastic map, then returns to MeshCore. Meshtastic packets go out at 0 hops by default (heard by direct neighbors, never rebroadcast); adjustable 0-3 via `mtbeacon hops`. Configure over the serial CLI with the `mtbeacon` commands (run `mtbeacon help`). v0.2.3: the beacon's chat text now goes out right after each MeshCore flood advert (it previously relied on an uptime timer that reset on every reboot and rarely fired), `mtbeacon status` shows a live countdown to the next text, and nRF52 boards gain a hardware watchdog that auto-reboots a hung node plus a queryable boot/reset reason (`get pwrmgt.bootreason`). Includes the v0.2.2 hard-hang and RX re-arm fixes. Recommended update; on-device settings are preserved.

Configure over the serial CLI with the `mtbeacon` commands (run `mtbeacon help`). v0.2.3: the beacon's chat text now goes out right after each MeshCore flood advert (it previously relied on an uptime timer that reset on every reboot and rarely fired), `mtbeacon status` shows a live countdown to the next text, and nRF52 boards gain a hardware watchdog that auto-reboots a hung node plus a queryable boot/reset reason (`get pwrmgt.bootreason`). Includes the v0.2.2 hard-hang and RX re-arm fixes. Recommended update; on-device settings are preserved.
